newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania sees 1997 wheat exports at 1.5 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Romania sees 1997 wheat exports at 1.5 mln tonnes.

text.p: Romania hopes to export around 1.5 million tonnes of wheat this year amid plans to re-emerge as a major player on the world grain market, a senior official said on Friday.

"So far, all conditions have been met for Romania to have a bumper wheat crop this year. If the weather helps us, we might export around 1.5 million tonnes of wheat," Agriculture Minister Dinu Gavrilescu told Reuters.
Gavrilescu's was the first official estimate for the country's wheat exports this year.
"Our plan is to return in force to the grain market with significant exports. I'm confident we will reach this target," he said.

Romania did not export wheat last year, when an early winter and late snows produced a poor crop. In 1995, Romania harvested a bumper crop of 7.8 million tonnes and sold about 1.3 million tonnes. -Adrian Dascalu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
